newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes slightly higher at 1,044.30.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes slightly higher at 1,044.30.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed slightly higher after getting a lift late in the session from dollar sales by exporters, interbank dealers said.
They said the peso, which traded in a 1,046.15 to 1,043.50 range, closed at 1,044.30, up 80 centavos on the dollar from Monday's close.
The peso held at 1,044.97 most of the session, but firmed in late trade on dollar sales by coffee exporters and insurance companies, dealers said.
They reported 406 trades for a total of $157.1 million.
